                    labour market

title_primary: 换工作：英国劳动力市场中的工人流动性与工资
title_secondary:

                    UK

authors: Pinjas Albagli, Nye Cominetti, Rui Costa, Andrew Eyles, Guglielmo Ventura
official: 官方在线 2026-08-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the role of job‐to‐job transitions in shaping wage dynamics in the UK. We show that job moves have continued to generate substantial wage gains for movers even during a period of real wage stagnation and declining labour market mobility. Using an econometric model that accounts for worker, firm and match heterogeneity, we decompose the job mobility premium, and find a limited role for worker and firm effects, with most of the return explained by match‐specific factors. We also examine the determinants of job mobility, and show that much of its recent decline reflects compositional changes in the workforce, particularly ageing and increasing occupational professionalization. We conclude by discussing the policy challenges of promoting job mobility as a driver of wage growth and more efficient labour market reallocation.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了英国工作转换在塑造工资动态中的作用。我们表明，即使在实际工资停滞和劳动力市场流动性下降的时期，工作变动仍持续为流动者带来可观的工资收益。通过一个考虑工人、企业和匹配异质性的计量经济学模型，我们分解了工作流动溢价，发现工人和企业效应作用有限，大部分回报归因于匹配特定因素。我们还考察了工作流动的决定因素，并显示其近期下降很大程度上反映了劳动力构成的变化，特别是老龄化及职业专业化程度的提高。最后，我们讨论了促进工作流动作为工资增长和更有效劳动力市场再配置驱动力的政策挑战。

title: Using growth-at-risk to assess the stance of macroprudential policy
title_zh: 运用增长风险法评估宏观审慎政策立场
title_primary: 运用增长风险法评估宏观审慎政策立场
title_secondary: Using growth-at-risk to assess the stance of macroprudential policy
authors: Stephen Cecchetti, Javier Suarez
official: 官方在线 2022-12-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The ultimate objective of macroprudential policy is to minimise the frequency and severity of economic losses arising from severe financial distress. Critically, any policymaker seeking to achieve this goal must be able to assess the stringency or laxity of their policy settings. Applying the lessons of monetary policy, we note that doing this requires a normative measure of policy stance based on a framework comprising an objective, tools, and a model linking the two. In this paper, we propose using growth-at-risk to define an overarching objective for macroprudential policy and then show how it can form the basis for a measure of policy stance. We proceed to discuss the challenges inherent in the implementation of our framework. These include the availability of appropriate data, choices among multiple tools, and gauging the uncertain responses of the economy and financial system to macroprudential policy actions.
abstract_zh: 宏观审慎政策的最终目标是最大限度地减少因严重金融困境而引发的经济损失的频率和严重性。关键在于，任何旨在实现这一目标的政策制定者都必须能够评估其政策设置的严格性或宽松性。借鉴货币政策的经验教训，我们注意到，要做到这一点，需要基于一个包含目标、工具及连接两者的模型的框架，来制定一个规范性的政策立场衡量标准。在本文中，我们提议使用风险增长值来定义宏观审慎政策的总体目标，并进而展示它如何构成政策立场衡量标准的基础。随后，我们讨论了实施我们框架所固有的挑战，包括适当数据的可用性、多种工具的选择，以及评估经济和金融体系对宏观审慎政策行动的不确定性反应。

title: Revisiting the Political Economy of Agriculture in 21st Century Food Systems
title_zh: 重访21世纪粮食系统中的农业政治经济学
title_primary: 重访21世纪粮食系统中的农业政治经济学
title_secondary: Revisiting the Political Economy of Agriculture in 21st Century Food Systems
authors: Danielle Resnick, Johan Swinnen
official: 官方在线 2026-08-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In 1932, Joseph Duncan argued in the Journal of Agricultural Economics that agricultural economists should engage more explicitly with politics. Nearly a century later, the political economy of food and agriculture has expanded in both scope and complexity. This paper revisits the evolution of political economy perspectives on agricultural policy, tracing the shift from early interest‐based explanations centered on farmers and consumers to broader frameworks that incorporate institutions, ideas and the interactions among diverse policy actors. We argue that contemporary transitions from an agricultural policy paradigm to a food systems one require a further rethinking of political economy analysis. Specifically, contemporary food systems pursue multiple and often competing objectives, including productivity, nutrition, environmental sustainability, resilience and equity, while involving a far wider array of stakeholders, from multinational corporations and transnational advocacy networks to technology firms and global governance institutions. At the same time, rising political polarization, populism, digital misinformation and the fragmentation of multilateral governance increasingly shape how policy preferences are formed, coalitions are constructed, and policy compromises are negotiated. These developments complicate traditional assumptions that preferences are driven primarily by material interests and that institutions can reliably facilitate collective action. We illustrate these changing dynamics through brief case studies of the 2024 European farmer protests, Brazil's Amazon Soy Moratorium and Mexico's genetically modified corn dispute. Each case highlights tensions between national sovereignty, global integration, environmental sustainability, and agricultural livelihoods. We conclude that understanding twenty‐first century food policy requires political economy frameworks that integrate interests, institutions, ideas and the changing geopolitical and informational context in which food system decisions are made.
abstract_zh: 1932年，约瑟夫·邓肯在《农业经济学杂志》上提出，农业经济学家应更明确地参与政治。近一个世纪后，食品与农业的政治经济学在范围和复杂性上均有所扩展。本文回顾了农业政策政治经济学视角的演变，追溯了从早期以农民和消费者为中心的利益解释，到纳入制度、思想及多元政策行动者互动的更广泛框架的转变。我们认为，当代从农业政策范式向食品系统范式的转型，要求对政治经济学分析进行进一步反思。具体而言，当代食品系统追求多重且往往相互竞争的目标，包括生产力、营养、环境可持续性、韧性和公平，同时涉及从跨国公司、跨国倡导网络到科技企业和全球治理机构等更为广泛的利益相关者。与此同时，日益加剧的政治极化、民粹主义、数字虚假信息以及多边治理的碎片化，正日益影响政策偏好的形成、联盟的构建以及政策妥协的谈判方式。这些发展使传统假设——即偏好主要由物质利益驱动，且制度能够可靠地促进集体行动——变得复杂化。我们通过2024年欧洲农民抗议、巴西亚马逊大豆暂停令以及墨西哥转基因玉米争端的简要案例研究，阐释了这些变化中的动态。每个案例都凸显了国家主权、全球一体化、环境可持续性与农业生计之间的张力。我们得出结论，理解21世纪的食品政策需要整合利益、制度、思想以及食品系统决策所处的不断变化的地缘政治和信息背景的政治经济学框架。

title: 消费和投资良性互动与长期经济增长
title_zh: 消费和投资良性互动与长期经济增长

official: 官方发布 2026-07-10 · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: 作为新型财政金融协同模式的典型工具，国库现金管理不仅能盘活财政存款资金、平滑市场流动性波动，还能引导商业银行调整信贷资源配置策略。以地方国库现金管理试点为背景，基于大样本宏微观数据，本文从理论层面和实证层面揭示了地方国库现金管理的“商业银行信用创造效应”和“地方政府信贷引导效应”。在信用创造层面，地方国库现金管理操作为商业银行注入了流动性，增加了商业银行信贷投放；在信贷引导层面，地方政府借助地方国库现金管理操作的激励与约束机制对商业银行进行适度干预，引导其将更多信贷资源配置至市场化转型较好的地方政府融资平台，进而对其他企业形成了信贷资源挤出效应。进一步研究揭示，地方政府基于财政资金安全性的考虑，促使信贷资源挤出效应主要集中于高风险企业与政策管制行业企业，这提高了商业银行信贷资源配置效率。在微观层面，上述导向改善了商业银行信贷质量，优化了企业的资本结构和资本配置效率，并且推动了宏观层面的地区基础设施建设和经济增长。本文研究结论为进一步推进财政与金融协同治理、国库现金管理改革等提供了重要政策启示。

title: Negotiating land, producing authority: hybrid rangeland governance on the pastoral Qinghai-Gansu Border, China
title_zh: 协商土地，生产权威：中国青海-甘肃牧区边境的混合牧场治理
title_primary: 协商土地，生产权威：中国青海-甘肃牧区边境的混合牧场治理
title_secondary: Negotiating land, producing authority: hybrid rangeland governance on the pastoral Qinghai-Gansu Border, China
authors: Palden Tsering
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Debates on property rights in pastoral China have largely focused on ownership, access, and more recently, transfer rights. However, everyday rangeland practices remain profoundly hybrid and insufficiently theorised. Drawing on eleven months of ethnographic fieldwork in Sog Zong, a pastoral county on the Qinghai-Gansu border, this paper examines how overlapping claims to rangeland are mediated through state contracts, religiously anchored agreements, village institutions, and conservation policies. Focusing on two cases, a bilateral rangeland use agreement historically mediated by the 10th Panchen Lama, and a recent state-led rangeland restoration project, the paper analyses how diverse institutional actors interact to shape access, exclusion, and control over land. Rather than treating these cases as instances of institutional plurality, the analysis demonstrates how authority is co-constituted across domains. The findings show that hybridity is best understood as arelational process in which authority emerges through ongoing practices of recognition, alignment, and contestation across institutional domains. This shifts analytical attention from identifying institutional diversity to examining how governance is actively produced through interaction. In doing so, the paper contributes to debates on hybrid governance and advances a practice-oriented understanding of property in pastoral contexts.
abstract_zh: 关于中国牧区产权问题的讨论，长期以来主要聚焦于所有权、使用权，以及近年来备受关注的流转权。然而，日常草原实践仍呈现出深刻的混合性，且理论化程度不足。本文基于在青海-甘肃交界处的牧业县——索宗地区为期十一个月的民族志田野调查，探讨了国家合同、宗教性协议、村庄制度及保护政策如何共同调解对草原的重叠性权利主张。通过聚焦两个案例——一是历史上由第十世班禅喇嘛调解的双边草原使用协议，二是近期由国家主导的草原恢复项目，本文分析了多元制度行动者如何相互作用，共同塑造对土地的获取、排斥与控制。本文并未将这些案例视为制度多元性的实例，而是论证了权威如何在各个领域间共同建构。研究结果表明，混合性最好被理解为一种关系性过程，在此过程中，权威通过跨制度领域的持续承认、协调与争辩实践而生成。这使分析焦点从识别制度多样性转向审视治理如何通过互动被积极生产。由此，本文为混合治理的讨论作出贡献，并推进了牧区情境下以实践为导向的产权理解。

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We explore how foreign central banks behave when firms engage in currency mismatch, borrowing heavily in dollars. A central bank can deal with risky private-sector mismatch in two ways: (i) with financial regulation or (ii) by accumulating reserves to better serve as a dollar lender of last resort. We highlight a novel externality: Individual central banks may overaccumulate dollar reserves, as this exacerbates a global scarcity of dollar-denominated assets, lowering dollar interest rates and encouraging firms to further increase their currency mismatch. Relative to the decentralized outcome, a global planner may prefer tighter financial regulation and reduced holdings of dollar reserves. (JEL E43, E44, E58, F31, F41, G21, G28)
abstract_zh: 本文探讨当企业存在货币错配、大量借入美元时，外国中央银行的行为模式。央行应对私营部门风险性货币错配有两种方式：（i）实施金融监管，或（ii）积累外汇储备以更好地充当美元最后贷款人。我们揭示了一种新颖的外部性：单个央行可能过度积累美元储备，因为这会加剧全球美元计价资产的稀缺性，压低美元利率，并鼓励企业进一步扩大其货币错配。相较于分散化决策的结果，全球规划者可能更倾向于实施更严格的金融监管并减少美元储备持有量。（JEL分类号：E43, E44, E58, F31, F41, G21, G28）

official: 官方在线 2026-06-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Many economic and financial series exhibit non-stationarity as well as long-memory behavior in both the first and second moments. To capture both non-stationarity and long-memory characteristics simultaneously, a general dual-trend and dual longmemory framework is proposed. In this framework, the error term of the semiparametric FARIMA model is assumed to exhibit a slowly changing scale and longmemory heteroskedasticity. A four-step estimation procedure is proposed, including a trend and a FARIMA model estimation for the first moment, followed by a scaling function and a long-memory volatility model estimation for the second moment. Three long-memory EGARCH-type models and the FIGARCH model are employed in the final stage. Our results indicate that the proposed approach can effectively model the selected economic series exhibiting dual-trend and dual long-memory features.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个广义市场因子（BMF），用以代表美国经济中所有企业（包括上市公司与非上市公司）的价值加权股权回报。BMF与标准价值加权市场因子（VMF）存在差异，后者仅反映上市公司的价值加权股权回报。我们将VMF与BMF之间的差值定义为特质金融因子（IFF）。IFF不包含风险溢价，且与我们考虑的所有投资者边际效用宏观经济代理变量均不相关。对于大多数投资组合而言，若以VMF而非BMF为基准进行测算，CAPM贝塔值及相应的贴现率将被低估。在标准因子模型中，若以BMF替代VMF，规模因子将变得冗余，规模异象亦随之消除。当以BMF替代VMF时，跨期风险-收益关系显著增强。这些结果的统一解释在于：IFF为VMF增添了非定价风险，从而扭曲了横截面与时间序列上对定价市场风险暴露程度的估计。

abstract: Prediction markets offer a new market-based approach to measuring macroeconomic expectations in real-time. We evaluate the accuracy of prediction market-implied forecasts from Kalshi, the largest federally regulated prediction market overseen by the CFTC. We compare Kalshi with more traditional survey and market-implied forecasts, examine how expectations respond to macroeconomic and financial news, and how policy signals are interpreted by market participants. Our results suggest that Kalshi markets provide a high-frequency, continuously updated, distributionally rich benchmark that is valuable to both researchers and policymakers.
abstract_zh: 预测市场提供了一种基于市场的新方法，用于实时衡量宏观经济预期。我们评估了由CFTC监管的、美国最大的联邦监管预测市场Kalshi所隐含预测的准确性。我们将Kalshi与传统调查及市场隐含预测进行比较，考察预期如何对宏观经济和金融新闻做出反应，以及市场参与者如何解读政策信号。研究结果表明，Kalshi市场提供了一个高频、持续更新、分布信息丰富的基准，对研究人员和政策制定者均具有重要价值。

title: Analyzing the economics of agroforestry within land use and land cover change: The case of the Baga-Kisimagonja ecological corridor of Tanzania
title_zh: 农林业在土地利用与土地覆盖变化中的经济学分析：坦桑尼亚巴加-基西马贡贾生态廊道案例研究

authors: Qambemeda Nyanghura, Paulo Mandela, Lilian Binego, Felister Mombo, Ulrich Schmutz
official: 官方在线 October 20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Deforestation poses significant ecological, economic, and social challenges globally. The magnitude of deforestation is, however, spatially heterogeneous, arguable to be higher in the productive agro-ecological landscapes such as in ecological corridors. Agroforestry systems and specifically Silvo-arable, offer a promising solution by balancing agricultural productivity with conservation goals. Their adoption, however, remains restrained due to limited awareness on economic viability and perceived risks among farmers. This study assessed the land use land cover changes of Baga Kisimagonja ecological corridor (BKG) in Tanzania between 1992 and 2022. The study further employs a probabilistic cost-benefit analysis (PCBA) to assess the economic viability of traditional agroforestry practices in comparison to conventional crop farming. The findings indicate that over the study period, crop land expanded at an annual rate of about three to six percent while agroforestry grew at a rate of less than three percent. Forest land decreased by an average of two percent per annum. Such land use dynamics is associated to a net carbon loss of 2.3–3.5 kt C year−1, valued at approximately 18771–32681 USD year−1. Additionally, our analysis showed that agroforestry systems are economically viable compared to conventional crop farming and more so when carbon benefits are integrated. We conclude that agroforestry has the potential to mitigate deforestation and enhance long-term land-use resilience if implemented effectively. The findings of this study are important to guide policymakers, farmers, and conservation organizations in making informed investments in agroforestry technologies and practices to restore the degraded ecosystems.

title: Climate change drives agricultural land use competition in the Paranapanema River Basin, Southeastern Brazil
title_zh: 气候变化驱动巴西东南部巴拉那帕内马河流域农业用地竞争
title_primary: 气候变化驱动巴西东南部巴拉那帕内马河流域农业用地竞争
title_secondary: Climate change drives agricultural land use competition in the Paranapanema River Basin, Southeastern Brazil
authors: Argemiro Teixeira Leite-Filho, Érica Acioli Canamary, Anaí Floriano Vasconcelos, Daniel Andrés Rodriguez, Jaqueline Carolino Santos 等
official: 官方在线 October 20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: To meet the growing global demands for food and biofuels, Brazilian soybean and sugarcane production must expand. Consequently, a comprehensive understanding of how climate-induced shifts will drive competition for agricultural land in critical regions is essential for sustainable development. Here, we investigate this potential conflict in the Paranapanema River Basin (PRB), focusing on the competition between soybean and sugarcane planted areas and analyzing how temperature and rainfall seasonality influence land-use decisions. Using predictive modeling, we simulate agricultural land-use changes for 2030, 2040, and 2050 under three climate scenarios (Baseline, SSP 2–4.5, and SSP 5–8.5). Our findings reveal that climate change will significantly reshape agricultural land-use dynamics in the PRB. Rising temperatures generally favor the conversion of pasture, soybean, and mosaic areas to sugarcane, but constrain soybean cultivation. Sugarcane thrives under moderate rainfall seasonality, while soybean expansion is suppressed under moderate (SSP 2–4.5) and high emissions (SSP 5–8.5) scenarios, while sugarcane area expands and pastureland consistently declines. Those trends reflect land-use policy constraints and favor carbon mitigation due to increase biofuel production. The mosaic area remains stable under the Baseline but decreases under the SSP scenarios. The shift from soybean to sugarcane, coupled with the decline in pastureland, underscores the dual pressures of economic demands and climate adaptation. These dynamics could have broader implications for Brazil’s agricultural exports, highlighting the need for diversification and climate-resilient practices. Policymakers must prioritize integrated strategies that balance agricultural productivity with environmental sustainability, while also promoting diversification to reduce reliance on a small number of commodities.

title: Adoption of Sustainable Livestock Innovations: Evidence from Latin America
title_zh: 采纳可持续畜牧业创新：来自拉丁美洲的证据
title_primary: 采纳可持续畜牧业创新：来自拉丁美洲的证据
title_secondary: Adoption of Sustainable Livestock Innovations: Evidence from Latin America
authors: Allen Blackman, Gonzalo Muñoz, Lina Salazar, Paul Winters
official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: To maintain the vital economic benefits of Latin America's livestock sector while minimizing its environmental footprint, producers must adopt clean and climate‐friendly ‘sustainable’ technologies including improved feed, grazing, reproductive, and herd management practices. Yet we have limited evidence on the barriers to and opportunities for the adoption of such technologies, and even less on that topic in Latin America and other developing regions where socioeconomic and geophysical conditions often differ from those in the developed countries. The product of a competitive open call by the Inter‐American Development Bank, the four articles that comprise the Special Focus aim to help fill that gap. Three examine the determinants of adoption in Mexico, Colombia, and Uruguay; and the fourth presents a quasi‐experimental impact evaluation of a program aimed at promoting adoption in Uruguay. The findings suggest that: (i) generalizing about the drivers of the adoption of sustainable livestock technologies in Latin America is ill advised: they are both technology‐ and site‐specific; (ii) land tenure matters; (iii) adopting one sustainable livestock technology does not necessarily increase the chances of adopting others; (iv) adoption does not guarantee significant impacts on targeted outcomes; and (v) two of the most common policy interventions—enhancing access to credit and providing technical extension—are correlated with adoption, at least for some technologies and subgroups.
abstract_zh: 为维持拉丁美洲畜牧业的重要经济效益，同时最大限度减少其环境足迹，生产者必须采用清洁且气候友好的"可持续"技术，包括改良饲料、放牧、繁殖及畜群管理实践。然而，关于此类技术采用的障碍与机遇，现有证据十分有限，而在社会经济与地理条件常异于发达国家的拉丁美洲及其他发展中地区，相关研究更为匮乏。作为美洲开发银行公开竞标成果，本专题聚焦的四篇文章旨在填补这一空白：其中三篇分别考察墨西哥、哥伦比亚和乌拉圭的技术采用决定因素，第四篇则对乌拉圭一项旨在促进技术采用的计划进行准实验影响评估。研究结果表明：（一）对拉丁美洲可持续畜牧业技术采用驱动因素进行泛化概括并不可取——这些因素既具有技术特异性又具有地域特异性；（二）土地权属至关重要；（三）采用某项可持续畜牧业技术并不必然增加采用其他技术的可能性；（四）技术采用并不能保证对目标结果产生显著影响；（五）两种最常见的政策干预措施——增强信贷可及性与提供技术推广服务——与技术采用存在相关性，至少对某些技术和子群体而言如此。

title: Eliciting and distinguishing between weak and incomplete preferences: Theory, experiment and computation
title_zh: 弱偏好与不完全偏好的引出与区分：理论、实验与计算
title_primary: 弱偏好与不完全偏好的引出与区分：理论、实验与计算
title_secondary: Eliciting and distinguishing between weak and incomplete preferences: Theory, experiment and computation
authors: Georgios Gerasimou
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We propose an experimental design and data‑analytic method for eliciting and distinguishing the strict‑preference, indifference, and indecisiveness components of individual preferences in general choice environments. The design combines a forced‑choice treatment with a free‑choice treatment. In both treatments, subjects may select multiple alternatives from a menu. In the free‑choice treatment, subjects may also avoid or delay choice at a small expected cost. To analyze such data, we extend a standard non‑parametric goodness‑of‑fit criterion to accommodate multi‑valued choices. We apply it to evaluate the consistency of subjects’ 50 decisions with utility maximization and two models of incomplete‑preference maximization. Around 55% of subjects are well explained by one of these models, with 33% and 22% best explained by utility and incomplete-preference maximization, respectively. Revealed preferences typically feature non-trivial indifferences, and those that are incomplete often exhibit the predicted theoretical distinctions between indifference and indecisiveness, which are documented empirically for the first time.

title: Assessing Basis Risk in Margin Insurance for Beef Cattle Farming in Brazil
title_zh: 评估巴西肉牛养殖利润保险中的基差风险
title_primary: 评估巴西肉牛养殖利润保险中的基差风险
title_secondary: Assessing Basis Risk in Margin Insurance for Beef Cattle Farming in Brazil
authors: Beatriz Salandin Dal Pozzo, Vitor Augusto Ozaki
official: 官方在线 2026-05-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Price volatility in agricultural markets directly affects the financial viability of rural producers, particularly in sectors characterized by narrow profit margins and long production cycles, such as beef cattle production. Futures contracts and agricultural insurance are commonly used to mitigate this risk; however, both instruments are exposed to basis risk, which arises from the divergences between futures and spot prices. This article has two objectives: to estimate the basis risk of futures contracts for fed cattle, feeder cattle, and corn, and to assess the basis risk associated with designing a gross margin insurance product adapted to the Brazilian context. The results show that basis risk for fed cattle and corn contracts was lower in São Paulo (7.51% and 4.85%, respectively) than in Mato Grosso do Sul (11.34% and 5.79%). Using state‐level prices as a proxy for feeder cattle futures reduced basis risk in both states, although the São Paulo proxy exhibited higher relative basis risk. The basis risk of the gross margin insurance product was estimated at 31.23% in São Paulo and 32.39% in Mato Grosso do Sul. These findings indicate that incorporating regional price differentials into margin insurance valuation is an effective policy strategy to reduce basis risk, allowing insured margins to better reflect local market conditions without introducing new futures contracts.
abstract_zh: 农产品市场价格波动直接影响农村生产者的财务可持续性，尤其在利润率低、生产周期长的行业（如肉牛养殖）中表现显著。期货合约和农业保险常被用于缓解此类风险，但两者均面临基差风险——即期货价格与现货价格之间的偏差。本文旨在实现两个目标：估算育肥牛、架子牛和玉米期货合约的基差风险，并评估适用于巴西背景的总利润保险产品设计中的基差风险。结果表明，圣保罗州育肥牛和玉米期货合约的基差风险（分别为7.51%和4.85%）低于南马托格罗索州（分别为11.34%和5.79%）。以州级价格作为架子牛期货的代理变量降低了两个州的基差风险，但圣保罗州的代理变量表现出更高的相对基差风险。总利润保险产品的基差风险在圣保罗州为31.23%，在南马托格罗索州为32.39%。这些发现表明，将区域价格差异纳入利润保险估值是降低基差风险的有效政策策略，可在不引入新期货合约的情况下，使保险利润更准确地反映当地市场条件。

title: Unintended Consequences of China’s Double Reduction Policy: Its Immediate and Intergenerational Impacts
title_zh: 中国“双减”政策的非预期后果：其即时与代际影响
title_primary: 中国“双减”政策的非预期后果：其即时与代际影响
title_secondary: Unintended Consequences of China’s Double Reduction Policy: Its Immediate and Intergenerational Impacts
authors: Liu, Xin, Meng, Xin, Pan, Guangqian, Zhao, Guochang
official: 官方在线 2026-05-04 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper evaluates the unintended consequences of China's 2021 "Double Reduction" policy, which aimed to ease students' academic burden by limiting homework and private tutoring. Using a tailored household survey, a constructed policy enforcement index, and a difference-in-differences design, we find that the policy increased private tutoring enrollment, household tutoring expenditures, and parental time spent on helping children with schoolwork. These effects disproportionately harmed low-income families, resulting in worse academic outcomes. Our findings suggest that the policy's effects run counter to its intended goals and may exacerbate educational inequality.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了中国2021年“双减”政策的非预期后果，该政策旨在通过限制作业和校外培训来减轻学生学业负担。利用定制化家庭调查、构建的政策执行指数以及双重差分设计，我们发现该政策增加了校外培训参与率、家庭培训支出以及家长辅导孩子功课的时间投入。这些效应不成比例地损害了低收入家庭，导致其学业表现恶化。研究结果表明，该政策的实际效果与其预期目标背道而驰，并可能加剧教育不平等。

title: Coping With Production Risk: Effects of Sown Plant Diversity on the Attractiveness of Crop Insurance in Grasslands
title_zh: 应对生产风险：播种植物多样性对草地作物保险吸引力的影响
title_primary: 应对生产风险：播种植物多样性对草地作物保险吸引力的影响
title_secondary: Coping With Production Risk: Effects of Sown Plant Diversity on the Attractiveness of Crop Insurance in Grasslands
authors: Nicolas Alou, Sergei Schaub, Martin Quaas, Robert Finger
official: 官方在线 2026-05-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Increased frequency of extreme weather events, particularly droughts, threatens grassland farming by destabilizing yields and farms' economic viability. We examine, theoretically and through numerical simulations, how sown plant diversity (natural insurance) influences the attractiveness of indemnity and drought index insurance (formal insurance) in grassland systems across Europe. Our analysis shows that higher sown diversity reduces farmers' willingness to pay for indemnity insurance, suggesting adverse selection. In contrast, drought index insurance remains equally attractive regardless of diversity. These effects hold across different insurance designs and risk preferences. Our findings offer valuable insights for farmers, insurers, and policymakers aiming to build resilient, sustainable agricultural systems.
abstract_zh: 极端天气事件（尤其是干旱）频率的增加，通过破坏产量和农场的经济可行性，威胁着草地农业。我们通过理论分析和数值模拟，研究了欧洲草地系统中播种植物多样性（自然保险）如何影响赔偿保险和干旱指数保险（正式保险）的吸引力。分析表明，较高的播种多样性降低了农民对赔偿保险的支付意愿，这表明存在逆向选择。相比之下，无论多样性如何，干旱指数保险的吸引力保持不变。这些效应在不同的保险设计和风险偏好下均成立。我们的研究结果为农民、保险公司和政策制定者提供了宝贵见解，旨在构建具有韧性和可持续性的农业系统。

title: Long‐term effects of economic depressions on wealth
title_zh: 经济萧条对财富的长期影响
title_primary: 经济萧条对财富的长期影响
title_secondary: Long‐term effects of economic depressions on wealth
authors: Viola Angelini, Irene Ferrari
official: 官方在线 2026-04-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the long-term effects of economic depressions – defined as multi-year peak-to-trough GDP declines of at least 10 percent – experienced until young adulthood on the wealth distribution and portfolio allocation of older individuals in Europe. We document that experiencing more economic depression years when young has a positive effect on wealth at older ages. By analyzing individual portfolio choices, preferences, and personality, we find that, while experiencing a depression makes individuals more risk averse, it also increases their financial planning horizon and conscientiousness. These results provide evidence that individuals who experienced economic depressions when young invest less in risky assets but save more, and thus tend to accumulate more wealth in the long run.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了经济萧条——定义为至少10%的多年峰值至谷底GDP下降——在个体年轻时期经历至成年早期，对欧洲老年人财富分配及资产组合配置的长期影响。我们记录到，年轻时经历更多经济萧条年份对老年时财富具有正向效应。通过分析个体投资组合选择、偏好及性格特征，我们发现，尽管经历萧条使个体更加风险厌恶，但也延长了其财务规划视野并增强了尽责性。这些结果提供了证据表明，年轻时经历过经济萧条的个体在风险资产上投资较少，但储蓄更多，从而在长期倾向于积累更多财富。

title: Falling trade barriers and rising crime? Evidence from Colombia
title_zh: 贸易壁垒下降与犯罪率上升？来自哥伦比亚的证据
title_primary: 贸易壁垒下降与犯罪率上升？来自哥伦比亚的证据
title_secondary: Falling trade barriers and rising crime? Evidence from Colombia
authors: Edgar Marcillo‐Yepez, Pilar Useche, Conner Mullally, Jaclyn Kropp, Maira Emy Reimão
official: 官方在线 2026-03-31 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Trade liberalization is central to development strategy in low‐ and middle‐income countries, yet its social costs, particularly for poor rural households, remain poorly understood and rarely offset by policy. Greater openness to trade generates benefits through lower prices, product diversity, and export earnings, but heightened import competition can reduce income and employment in exposed sectors, potentially increasing crime by lowering the opportunity cost of illicit activity. Rising agricultural import competition is particularly concerning given that poverty in the developing world is disproportionately rural and that large shares of the labor force depend on smallholder farming. Here, using panel data from 887 Colombian municipalities and a shift‐share instrumental variables approach, we show that the U.S.‐Colombia Free Trade Agreement of 2012—by intensifying import competition in corn and beans—raised home burglaries and robberies of individuals by 16% and 6%, respectively, while reducing business robberies by 13%. Crime impacts were concentrated in Andean municipalities and non‐coca‐producing regions, reflecting the vulnerability of smallholder traditional corn producers to a surge of cheap U.S. imports and the limited economic alternatives available in those areas. Unlike prior studies from Mexico and Brazil, we find non‐robust evidence of impacts on homicides—a divergence explained by Colombia's context of de‐escalating armed conflict, which dampened extreme violence while leaving economically motivated property crime fully exposed. These results call for agricultural trade agreements to be explicitly paired with rural safety nets and labor market policies capable of preventing trade‐induced shocks from translating into elevated crime and deepened rural inequality.
abstract_zh: 贸易自由化是中低收入国家发展战略的核心，但其社会成本，尤其是对贫困农村家庭的影响，仍鲜为人知且很少通过政策加以补偿。更大的贸易开放度通过降低价格、增加产品多样性和出口收入带来益处，但进口竞争的加剧可能减少受冲击部门的收入和就业，并通过降低非法活动的机会成本而潜在地增加犯罪。鉴于发展中国家的贫困问题主要集中在农村地区，且大量劳动力依赖小农耕作，农业进口竞争的加剧尤为令人担忧。本文利用哥伦比亚887个市镇的面板数据和转移份额工具变量方法，研究表明2012年《美国-哥伦比亚自由贸易协定》通过加剧玉米和豆类进口竞争，使入室盗窃和个人抢劫分别上升了16%和6%，同时使商业抢劫下降了13%。犯罪影响集中在安第斯山脉市镇和非古柯生产地区，反映了小农传统玉米种植者对美国廉价进口激增的脆弱性以及这些地区有限的经济替代选择。与先前来自墨西哥和巴西的研究不同，我们发现对凶杀案影响的证据并不稳健——这一差异可归因于哥伦比亚武装冲突逐步降级的背景，这一背景抑制了极端暴力，却使出于经济动机的财产犯罪完全暴露。这些结果要求农业贸易协定必须明确配套农村安全网和劳动力市场政策，以防止贸易引发的冲击转化为犯罪率上升和农村不平等加剧。
